quests.question: I usually eat ___ egg for breakfast before school.
quests.sentence: I usually eat ___ egg for breakfast before school.
quests.hint: 'Egg' starts with which kind of sound?
quests.explanation: 'Egg' begins with a vowel sound, so it takes 'an'. We say 'an egg', not 'a egg'.

quests.question: I get ready in ___ bathroom every morning before anyone else wakes up.
quests.sentence: I get ready in ___ bathroom every morning before anyone else wakes up.
quests.hint: There's only one bathroom in the house that everyone knows about.
quests.explanation: 'The' is used when a shared situation makes it obvious which one is meant. Here, everyone in the house knows which bathroom.

quests.question: My grandmother was born in ___ Canada many years ago.
quests.sentence: My grandmother was born in ___ Canada many years ago.
quests.hint: Most country names don't need an article.
quests.explanation: Most country names, like Canada, Japan, or Brazil, take no article. We say 'in Canada', not 'in the Canada'.

quests.question: We found ___ wooden bench under the big tree.
quests.sentence: We found ___ wooden bench under the big tree.
quests.hint: 'Wooden' starts with a consonant sound.
quests.explanation: 'Wooden' begins with a consonant sound, so it takes 'a'. We say 'a wooden bench', not 'an wooden bench'.

quests.question: There's a fountain in the middle of the park. ___ fountain lights up at night.
quests.sentence: There's a fountain in the middle of the park. ___ fountain lights up at night.
quests.hint: This fountain is the one already named.
quests.explanation: Something mentioned for a second time takes 'the'. 'The fountain' points back to that exact fountain.

quests.question: ___ children love climbing on the playground equipment.
quests.sentence: ___ children love climbing on the playground equipment.
quests.hint: This is a general comment about children as a group.
quests.explanation: To make a general statement about a whole group, use the plain plural noun. 'Children love climbing' means children in general.

quests.question: She used ___ electric mixer to make the batter.
quests.sentence: She used ___ electric mixer to make the batter.
quests.hint: What sound opens the word 'electric'?
quests.explanation: 'Electric' starts with a vowel sound, so it takes 'an'. We say 'an electric mixer'.

quests.sentence: Dad is fixing a leaky faucet in the kitchen. ___ faucet has been dripping for days.
quests.hint: You already read about this faucet once.
quests.explanation: Once something is introduced, we refer to it again using 'the'. 'The faucet' means that same leaky faucet.

quests.question: In the evening, my parents like to cook ___ pasta for the whole family.
quests.sentence: In the evening, my parents like to cook ___ pasta for the whole family.
quests.hint: Pasta is treated as a general food here, not one countable item.

quests.question: A new family moved into ___ big house next door.
quests.sentence: A new family moved into ___ big house next door.
quests.hint: 'Big' starts with a consonant sound.
quests.explanation: Use 'a' before a consonant sound. 'Big' begins with 'b', so we say 'a big house'.

quests.question: There's a small bakery on our street. ___ bakery sells fresh bread every morning.

quests.hint: Names of games don't take an article.

quests.question: For his birthday, he wanted ___ action figure from his favorite show.

quests.question: I borrowed ___ funny story from the library.

quests.question: This is ___ third bus stop before ours.
